About the Sunday Cruise ATX group ride

Sunday Cruise ATX is a social, cruiser and e-bikes welcome group ride in Austin, TX. It rolls second Sunday of the month at 11:00 am from Changes monthly; Sept 13 started at the Amphitheater at Girard Kinney Park.

A relaxed social bike ride on the second Sunday of each month, going since 2016. The route is easy with few hills and stops at markets, cafes and free events. The club says it suits beginners.
